_doc: Rows for research/official_surprises.py. Rows, never code: a new release is a row. terms != OPEN is never fetched and is a named gap. key_env lists env var NAMES only; no value ever lives here. Ids marked catalogue_checked are verified against the source's own catalogue on every live pass before use.

rows.title: Fed H.4.1 net liquidity
rows.why: Reserves added by the Fed balance sheet net of the Treasury cash account and reverse repo are the dollars actually free to bid risk; the weekly change is the H.4.1 event, Thursday 16:30 ET.
Secured overnight funding above the rate on reserves means reserves are scarce; AA financial CP above bills means banks pay up for term dollars. Both precede dollar squeezes and risk-off.

The overnight forward the broker finances at, minus the cash-rate differential, is a covered-interest-parity basis: when dollars are scarce it widens. Distinct from GAP_MAP 52 (swap drift is the swap's own change; this is its gap to cash).

rows.title: EIA weekly natural gas storage
rows.why: Storage is the realised supply-demand balance; a build below the 5-year same-week average is a tighter market than weather alone said (distinct from N2 degree-days).

rows.terms_note: USDA FAS, US public domain; API needs a free api.data.gov key
rows.why: Weekly net export sales against their own 4-week mean is the foreign-demand surprise for US grains, released Thursday 08:30 ET.

rows.title: TIC net foreign purchases of US long-term securities
rows.why: Foreign appetite for US long-term assets against its 12-month median is a slow dollar and duration flow; the state holds release day + 1 week.

rows.terms_note: BoJ data free to reuse with attribution (ledger 11-11). Fetcher waits on a box read of one results page and one monthly schedule page: boj.or.jp is refused by the cloud egress, so the field map cannot be read from here; held rows are served.
rows.title: BoJ JGB outright purchase result
rows.why: An operation offered below its pre-announced bucket plan, or heavily over-covered, says the BoJ is stepping back or the market is dumping duration on it: a same-day yen and Nikkei state.
